lead: An infallible allocation on a caller-supplied count aborts the process — exit 127, nothing on stderr, nothing catchable, every in-flight request with it.
body: `nvs_runtime::affordable` refuses only a size past `isize::MAX`, so a count below it the machine cannot serve reaches `vec![…; n]`, `String::with_capacity` or `NvsStr::build` and dies. Draw through `NvsStr::try_build`, `NvsArray::try_reserve` or the `*_fallibly` helpers in `str.rs`/`bytes.rs`/`arr.rs`, and add the member to `tests/conformance/core/count-shaped-producers-refuse-alike.nvst`.
